name: agenai-agent-sdk
description: Provider-neutral TypeScript contracts for hosting coding agents.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agenai/validation build && pnpm --filter @agenai/agent-protocol build && pnpm --filter @agenai/agent-runtime build
scripts.check: pnpm check:repository && pnpm check:generated && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck:packages && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:external-consumer
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:external-consumer
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @agenai/validation test && pnpm --filter @agenai/agent-protocol test && pnpm --filter @agenai/agent-runtime test
scripts.typecheck:packages: pnpm --filter @agenai/validation typecheck && pnpm --filter @agenai/agent-protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @agenai/agent-runtime typecheck
